hero.title: Time, taken apart.
hero.intro: Nine automatic watches in steel, gold and ceramic. Scroll to see what sits beneath the crystal, one layer at a time.

crystal.title: Sapphire crystal
crystal.body: Domed, coated on the inside against glare, and hard enough that only diamond will scratch it.

bezel.title: 18k gold bezel
bezel.body: Turned from a solid gold ring and polished by hand to a mirror finish.

hands.title: Hands
hands.body: Faceted, filled with luminous material and balanced so they sweep evenly.

dial.title: Sunburst dial
dial.body: Brushed in radiating lines, so the navy shifts as light moves across it.

movement.title: Automatic movement
movement.body: 28,800 beats an hour, wound by the motion of your wrist.

caseback.title: Case back
caseback.body: Screwed down and sealed to 100 metres, with a sapphire window onto the rotor.

bracelet.title: Bracelet
bracelet.body: Solid links in steel and gold, joined by screws rather than pins.

about.metaDescription: United WatchMart builds automatic watches by hand and explains every part that goes into them.
about.label: About
about.title: We make watches you can understand.
about.intro: United WatchMart began with a simple idea: a fine watch should not be a mystery. You should know what is inside it, how it was made and why it costs what it does.
about.s1Body: Each watch is assembled, regulated and tested by one watchmaker from start to finish. Their initials are recorded against the serial number, so every piece has a name behind it.
about.s2Body: We publish what goes into every reference: the case material, the movement, the reserve, the finishing. Our Anatomy pages take a watch apart so you can see it for yourself.
about.s3Body: Bracelets are joined with screws, movements are built to be opened, and spare parts are kept for decades. A good watch should outlive the person who first buys it.
about.s4Body: We would rather you try a watch on than buy it from a photograph. Private viewings are free, unhurried and without obligation.

legal.metaDescription: How United WatchMart handles your data and the terms that apply to this website.
legal.label: Legal
legal.title: Privacy and terms.
legal.privacy1: We collect only what you give us: your name, email, phone number and message when you request a viewing, and your email if you join our newsletter.
legal.privacy2: We use these details to answer your enquiry and arrange your appointment. We do not sell or rent your data, and we share it only with the services that deliver our email and protect our forms from spam.
legal.privacy3: You can ask us to see, correct or delete your data at any time by replying to any email we send you.
legal.terms1: Prices and specifications on this site are shown for information and may change without notice. A purchase is confirmed only when you receive a written order confirmation.
legal.terms2: All text, images, models and designs on this site belong to United WatchMart and may not be reused without permission.
legal.terms3: Viewings are free and place you under no obligation to buy.
